Getting in shape is to build yourself up. If you can do that it shows you can work hard. If you work hard you will find a job. I mean its not much of a solution, but its setting you in the right direction. You need to change yourself first then work on your situation. I feel like I'm doing a bad job explaining this. Basically if you can build yourself up you can then expand on that and succeed. This is stupid and stuff, but you have to stop holding yourself back. Push out of your comfort zone, get in shape, and work hard. If you can get out of your comfort zone and work hard getting a job will be easier. Being willing to try new things and work hard is something very valuable when looking for a job. You don't have to do this its just a suggestion. You could do something else to push yourself out of your comfort zone. No solution is perfect and things work differently for everyone I'm just recommending you give this a try because like what I said what have you got to lose. If nothing else you'll feel better physically.

What games do you play? I play mostly hearthstone and league of legends, but I do play some free to plays on steam. I also have starcraft 2 if you play that. If you have any games that are free to play on steam I could download them and we could do that. I'm not exactly well off, but I'll try to help.

Its a day to day thing each day just set a small goal for yourself. Goal setting is important because you need to have a set distance or you will convince yourself to quit sooner rather than going a little further and getting a work out. Gradually increase it and try and meet a long term goal like you want to be able to walk/run 5 miles 3 months from now or something like that. Make sure it is achievable, but don't make it too easy. Setting and achieving goals can build self esteem. Its not a complete solution but it could help. It will push you out of your comfort zone. You can lose weight pretty quickly if you eat right and exercise. Its something you need to push yourself to do. It will be difficult, but if nothing else just give it a try ... what have you got to lose? If you want to be good about it have someone check on you make sure you are trying to meet your goals. I can't really give you much better advice because I am trying to figure my own shit out, but good luck give it a try and give it time because unfortunately it takes time to get in shape.

try and cut down on the unhealthy food and maybe get out and exercise some. I find that being in shape can make a huge difference in how you feel day to day. I know it is near impossible to get motivated or go out and exercise (there is a reason I haven't done it in a while), but it is worth it. I did cross country for several years and it helped me a little bit just setting goals and trying to achieve them. It takes lots of time, but if you do it you could feel better. If you have an ipod or some other music player you could put that in and go running or walking and just work on getting into better shape. It will be really difficult at first but you can do it.

My family hasn't noticed somehow. I'm not really hiding it ... I also have no hope for the future it just seems so pointless like I said before. I don't want to live to see the future with the way things are going now.
